channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anfernee Simons | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anfernee Simons from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Georges Niang, Anfernee Simons
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Brad Stevens on the broadcast talking losses:

“It's part of this new CBA and obviously the 2nd apron... We're lucky to get the guys that we got back in those trades,specifically Simons and Niang.”

Brad Stevens on Georges Niang, Anfernee Simons, Jul 13, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin:

“What I will say about Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson and Anfernee Simons is that they're going to be 'win-now' players very, very soon.”

Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Scoot Henderson, Shaedon Sharpe, Jul 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Anfernee Simons
item.description:
Damian Lillard on Anfernee Simons' third quarter:

“Explosive. And fun. I was looking around at the crowd like, 'Man, this is crazy. He's blowing the roof off the place.' ... It was special to watch.”

Damian Lillard on Anfernee Simons, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons
item.description:
Cronin continued,

“Anfernee is already one of the league’s top shooters and this past season he showed elite ability as a shot creator and distributor. We are excited for him to continue the growth he has shown in his first four seasons in Portland.”

Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Jul 6, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic, Anfernee Simons
item.description:
“It was incredibly important to us to bring back both Jusuf Nurkic and Anfernee Simons as key pieces of our core,”

Joe Cronin on Jusuf Nurkic, Anfernee Simons, Jul 6, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons' restricted free agency:

“My goal would be to be proactive. We have a good relationship with Anfernee and his agency. I would hope that once we're allowed to start talking we can come to an agreement that makes sense for both sides.”

Joe Cronin on Anfernee Simons, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Anfernee Simons
item.description:
Neil Olshey on Anfernee Simons:

“At that point in the draft, we’re looking for the guy with the highest ceiling we could possibly find. He’s really gifted.”

Neil Olshey on Anfernee Simons, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.
